Organisation and studies · in French

Dissertation or thesis planner

For master's students, engineering students writing their final-year report and PhD candidates: the outline with the status and word count of each section, a backward schedule from the submission date (editable milestones), the words per working day still needed compared with the actual pace, meetings with the supervisor and their actions, a simple reading list. Your text is never read: you copy the word counts. Suggested milestones are indicative, not official rules.
